# Sidebar

The side navigation of an app, open while people work.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-sidebar--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:light" title="Sidebar examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-sidebar--docs">Open Sidebar in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-sidebar--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:dense-data;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** App navigation that stays open all shift.

- **Use it when:** Apps with several sections people move between all session.
- **Not when:** A website's main navigation (navigation menu), or a few sections that fit in tabs.

Instead:

- [Navigation menu](./navigation-menu.md): Website navigation.
- [Tabs](./tabs.md): Views of one thing.

## Why it works this way

Sidebar looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Sidebar, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Numbers and records</div><p>Most of the screen is numbers and records.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Sidebar</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Menu items with no border, quiet beside dense data.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>outline</b>: Borders on every item would compete with the data.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: neutral</code> <code>Badge: info</code> <code>Badge: success</code> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Badge: danger</code> <code>Empty: default</code> <code>Item: default</code> <code>Item: outline</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">4</div><small>Sidebar decisions would reopen</small><p>and 44 answers that follow from it: <b>A lot</b>, <b>Scan and compare</b>, <b>People keep their place</b>, and 41 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How often do people repeat actions?</b><code>tasks.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Constantly</div><p>The same actions repeat many times an hour.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Sidebar</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Every section of the app.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: ghost</code> <code>Input group: inline-end</code> <code>Alert: default</code> <code>Toast: success</code> <code>Toggle: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Sidebar decision would reopen</small><p>and 11 answers that follow from it: <b>Time on task</b>, <b>All day</b>, <b>Three</b>, and 8 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-spacing-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many densities exist?</b><code>spacing.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Two</div><p>A second, denser size serves tables and toolbars.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Sidebar</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>sm</b>: Long secondary lists, at the denser size.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Item: default</code> <code>Item: sm</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Sidebar decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How much is on one screen?</b><code>content.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">A lot</div><p>Experts want many records on one screen.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Sidebar</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>lg</b>: Rows stay small so the whole navigation fits the screen all shift.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: default</code> <code>Button: compact</code> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Input group: block-start</code> <code>Input group: block-end</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: sm</code> <code>Toggle: lg</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Sidebar decision would reopen</small><p>and 14 answers that follow from it: <b>Quiet</b>, <b>Only the steps the screens need</b>, <b>Small</b>, and 11 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a navigation landmark; the current section is marked; collapsing keeps names for icons. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add sidebar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
